_context.title: A linked computer is a person's own machine (laptop, desktop, workstation) where the workspace's AI coworkers can run commands and long jobs. Keep "Computers" short.
_context.status.busy: Badge on a computer currently running one or more long jobs started by a coworker.
_context.modes.remember.label: Approval mode: the first time a program runs the person is asked, and can say "always allow" for it.
_context.linkDialog.handle: {handle} is rendered as #handle, the word typed in the chat to name this computer (e.g. #studio-pc). Keep the tag around it.
_context.thisComputer.inWorkspace: Follows the #handle of the computer, e.g. "#studio-pc in Acme". {workspace} is the workspace name.

title: Computers
description: Your own computers, where coworkers run commands and long jobs

thisComputer.heading: This computer
thisComputer.offer: Let coworkers run commands and long jobs here
thisComputer.offerLong: Coworkers can run commands and long jobs here, each new program with your approval
thisComputer.pauseHint: Nothing runs here until you resume
thisComputer.unlinkBody: Coworkers of {workspace} will no longer run anything here. You can link it again later.
thisComputer.noKeychain: This system has no keychain: the link is kept in a file only your account can read.

linkFromApp: Link a computer from the desktop app.
engineNeedsUpdate: Computers arrive with the next update of this workspace's machine. They show offline until then.
engineUnreachable: The workspace's machine is not answering: computers show offline for now.
managersOnly: Only an admin or the person who linked it can change this
settingsNeedEngine: Available once the workspace's machine answers

empty.title: No computer linked
empty.body: Coworkers run heavy work on your own machine: video, local models, your GPU.

status.busy: {count, plural, one {Running a job} other {# jobs running}}

ask.label: Ask every time
ask.description: Every command waits for a yes

remember.label: Ask, then remember
remember.description: Always allow a program once you trust it

full.label: Full access
full.description: Runs without asking, except sensitive folders

detail.offlineSince: Offline since {when}. Coworkers say so instead of running anything.
detail.neverConnected: Not connected yet. It shows online once the Rerun app runs on it.
detail.paused: Paused from the computer itself. Nothing runs until it is resumed there.
detail.unattendedHint: Schedules, triggers and other coworkers can use it
detail.nothingAllowed: Nothing yet. Choose “Always allow” on an approval in the chat.
detail.interpreterWarning: Allowing an interpreter allows any code it runs
detail.screenOn: On. Coworkers can see and use the screen, one conversation at a time.
detail.screenOff: Off. It can only be turned on from the Rerun app on this computer.
detail.removeBody: Coworkers will no longer run anything on it. Its rules are forgotten, and it can be linked again from the desktop app.
